headline: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has officially approved the Makkah Agreement on Joint Defense with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, completing Turkiye's ratification, the Turkish official gazette reported on Friday, according to Arab News (Reuters).

card.desc: Erdogan approves pact with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia

caption:
Turkiye completes ratification of the Makkah defence pact! 🤝
According to Arab News (Reuters), the Turkish official gazette reported on Friday that President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has officially approved the Makkah Agreement on Joint Defense with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, completing Turkiye's ratification. The Turkish Parliament approved it on November 5. The three countries signed the agreement in Makkah in August; under it, an attack on one party is treated as an attack on all. The three nations are scheduled to hold meetings in Islamabad on Friday and Saturday.
